independence_note: The zero-context auditor was a fresh sub-agent of the same model family. Its verdict is an input, not an acceptance: the executor re-derived every finding from the paper's own declared source JSON before acting. 6 of 11 flagged anomalies were false positives traced to the auditor reading the wrong evidence file.

confirmed_defects.paper_text: minimum detectable difference is 2.98 points --- larger than the entire 3.98-point spread of the fourteen backbones
confirmed_defects.problem: 2.98 is smaller than 3.98; 'larger than' is arithmetically false. The true relation is 2.98/3.98 = 74.8%.
confirmed_defects.fix_applied: 'larger than the entire' -> '75% of the entire' in all three locations

confirmed_defects.paper_text: architecture accounts for 0.54% of the variance ... against 95.32% for the category --- a factor of 176
twelve well-behaved backbones ... pooled medians span 7.538-7.971 with CV between 2.2% and 12.1%
confirmed_defects.evidence_value: per-config cv grouped by backbone, per-backbone CV = mean of 3 dim CVs: 11 backbones span 2.20%-12.09% (vit_tiny 8.78, resnet18 11.54, swin_tiny 12.09); efficientnet_b0 = 74.00% with median proxy 11.646; eff_b1 = 169.5%, mobilenetv3 = 180.9%
confirmed_defects.problem: The 2.2-12.1% range and the 7.538-7.971 span describe ELEVEN backbones. The set called 'twelve well-behaved' includes efficientnet_b0, whose CV is 74% and whose median proxy (11.65) lies far outside the quoted band.
confirmed_defects.fix_applied: restated as 'eleven tight non-collapsing backbones' (2.2-12.1%, span 7.54-7.97) with efficientnet_b0 reported separately at CV 74%; Table 2 row changed to 2.2--74.0; Fig.2 caption and conclusion 5.7% figure re-scoped to the eleven

confirmed_defects.paper_text: the aggregated policy means over the three seeds are 82.36% for the default and 90.28% for top-k
confirmed_defects.evidence_value: seeds = [43, 44]; n_cells = 30; mean_auroc_by_policy.sum_mean = 0.8235983654987252; sum_topk = 0.9028476703746848; by_seed 43 -> gain 8.07pp, 44 -> gain 7.78pp
confirmed_defects.problem: The file aggregates two seeds (43, 44), not three. Combining with the seed-42 model (82.80/90.21) gives a true three-seed figure of 82.51/90.26 (+7.75).
confirmed_defects.fix_applied: 5.2 now states the 2-seed aggregate 82.36/90.28 and the 3-seed figure 82.51/90.26 side by side, explaining that the seed-42 model enters via a different evaluation script; introduction changed to 'from 82.5% to 90.3% --- +7.8 points'

confirmed_defects.paper_text: the two collapse-prone backbones return exactly 0.0 whenever their student diverges (implying collapse is exclusive to efficientnet_b1 and mobilenetv3_small_100); 'efficientnet_b0 ... which does not collapse'
confirmed_defects.evidence_value: exact-0.0 counts over 1190 trials: efficientnet_b1 59/72 (81.9%), mobilenetv3_small_100 19/87 (21.8%), efficientnet_b0 2/79 (2.5%; run08 trial 63, run10 trial 32)
confirmed_defects.problem: efficientnet_b0 is not collapse-free. Asserting exclusivity supports a blacklist, whereas the paper's recommendation is a filter.
confirmed_defects.fix_applied: added the b0 counts (2/79) and the b1/mnv3 rates, reframed the recommendation as a filter that cannot be a blacklist; 'which does not collapse' softened to 'collapses only rarely and never in those four runs'

rejected_as_false_positive.auditor_claim: Table tab:fusion top-k worst category 78.37 conflicts with fusion_ksweep 76.46
rejected_as_false_positive.why: fusion_policy/fusion_policy.json (the paper's declared source, 82 policies) gives uniform sum_topk worst = pill 78.37 exactly. fusion_ksweep is a second script over a 22-policy grid, whose 76.46 belongs to a different pooling set.

rejected_as_false_positive.auditor_claim: 'We evaluate 82 policies' - own enumeration sums to 108+, contradicts the 111 in another caption
rejected_as_false_positive.why: fusion_policy/fusion_policy.json contains exactly 82 policy keys and reproduces 82.80/42.22/90.21/78.37/90.60/93.72 exactly. The 111 figure belongs to pseudo_select and is stated in that table's own caption.
pseudo_select.json, _s43.json and _s44.json all give n_fit=146, n_holdout=63 (69.9%/30.1%) for bottle. policy_select.json is a different experiment.

final_truth_analysis.json gives mobilenetv3_small_100 = 0.8185265904073151 at rank 7 of 14. The 0.819547 the auditor used comes from search_repeats_summary.json, a separate computation over the recorded search runs.

phaseB_truth.json holds 390 entries = seed 42 (210 = 14x15) + seeds 43/44 (90 each). final_truth_analysis.json decomposes the seed-42 matrix with df=[13,182], matching the paper. The 210-detector matrix and the 180-residual-df noise estimate refer to different objects and are both correct.
Table means are rounded to 2 dp; on unrounded values the difference is 1.06. A 0.01 pp gap is display rounding, not an error.

out_of_scope.reason: External-literature values (PatchCore 99.1%, SimpleNet/DINomaly 99.6%), the publication status of SPADE/FastFlow, and the 'first comparison' novelty claim are statements about the published record, not the paper's own experiments. Not verifiable against internal evidence; citation entries were checked separately.

Method protocol constants (epochs, batch size, lr, seeds, k=1%, B=256) cannot be traced because unsupervised_nas/configs/*.yaml were not supplied to the auditor. Recommended follow-up: add the config files to the evidence set and re-run S2. No contradiction found.

Artefacts that exist in the release repository G:/kg-nas-diagnosis/ but were outside the compacted evidence bundle supplied in this run. Where the paper cites them, values were confirmed by direct computation in the verification pass.
